description: The Grant Management API's decisions, over REST and MCP alike (GrantOperations): a grant evaluated by the PDP, one refused by the authorization server before the PDP was asked, and one revoked. Never a token, a consent's contents or the PDP's messages.

grant_id.description: The grant asked about: PingFederate's grant guid, as the path carried it. Absent when the request named no grant the store holds.

client_id.description: The OAuth client the access token was issued to.

decision.description: What the PDP answered: permit or deny.

reason_id.description: The stable reason id: the PDP's first user-facing reason for an evaluation (consent_covers_request, subject_not_entitled), or the authorization server's refusal code (grant_not_found, unauthorized, insufficient_scope, grant_expired). Never the message.

gm.grant.evaluated.description: The PDP answered an evaluation (section 6.7) of a grant the caller may act on: permit or deny, with its reason id. An unreachable PDP is not an answer and emits nothing here.

gm.grant.refused.description: The authorization server refused an evaluation before the PDP was asked (section 8.4.2): no such grant, another client's grant, an expired grant, a missing scope or resource, or a grant with no subject. The reason is the refusal code.

gm.grant.revoked.description: A client revoked a grant it holds (section 6.3), with grant_management_revoke.
